description: This file defines an abstract class ConfigurationSupportingVerticle that extends Vertx's AbstractVerticle. It provides support for managing configuration properties of a generic type T, including methods to set specific configuration, enforce subclass implementation for setting configuration, and retrieve the current configuration.

classes.name: ConfigurationSupportingVerticle
classes.description: An abstract base class for Vertx verticles that supports configuration management of a generic type T.

methods.name: setSpecificConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration object of type T used for configuring the verticle.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to set configuration properties. Intended for injection or external configuration purposes.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object of type T, or null if not set.
